name: wp-tests
title: Wreckage Pollution test gate
author: Sparr
description: Carries no prototypes of its own. Its presence is what tells Wreckage Pollution to register its test suite, so the fixtures can never run on a player machine, and it flattens the rocket launch timings so the space platform fixture does not sit through a cinematic. Published with the mod source on GitHub, but never to the mod portal.
